name: Hearth grass carp
summary: Grass carp smoked on the hearth. Báo Sơn La, on 15 May 2025, names cá trắm gác bếp as a later product of the Chiềng Cơi workshop, beside chẩm chéo and pork belly. A separate fish recipe was not printed. The workshop’s smoke for the meats is 1–2 hours of seasoning, then about 6–8 hours.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 15 May 2025. Tổ 3, phường Chiềng Cơi.
howToEat: As the smoked fish, or carry it. A fish-only seasoning list, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi. No stall is a pick.
seoTitle: Ca tram gac bep in Son La — hearth grass carp
seoDescription: Cá trắm gác bếp in Sơn La, named by Báo Sơn La as a Chiềng Cơi hearth product. A separate fish recipe was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
